caption: A heavy bucket hung from the handle of a backyard zip line is released and rides it down to the far end, the cable sagging under it.

sa.check: A bucket hangs from the handle of a zip line.
It rides down the cable to the far end.
The release comes first and the ride follows.

pc.expect: The cable dips most under the handle and the dip travels with the bucket; it stays straight on either side and does not stretch.
pc.fail: The cable stays level under the bucket; or it sags everywhere at once; or it stretches longer; or it bends upward.

pc.expect: The bucket runs downhill along the cable, speeding up, and slows at the far end; it hangs below the cable.
pc.fail: The bucket climbs; or it stops mid-run with nothing in its way; or it rises above the cable.

pc.expect: The bucket moves only after release and stops at the end.
pc.fail: It moves before release; or sets off again after reaching the end; or changes speed with nothing acting on it.

pc.expect: The bucket follows the cable's line, swinging a little, and the handle stays on the cable.
pc.fail: The bucket swings off to the side of the cable's line; or it spins; or the handle leaves the cable and the bucket keeps going.

pc.expect: One bucket, one handle and one cable keep their number.
pc.fail: The bucket vanishes or a second appears; or the handle passes through the cable; or the bucket turns into another object.

pc.expect: The bucket, the cable and the yard stay the same.
pc.fail: The bucket changes colour; or the cable changes; or the yard rearranges.
